_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'QUALITY METRICS' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.05.02.

f01_Metric_Name_and_Target_Standard.label: Metric Name and Target Standard
f01_Metric_Name_and_Target_Standard.guidance: The specific quality attribute, measurable KPI, and approved benchmark target value.

f02_Associated_Deliverable_and_Work_Pack.label: Associated Deliverable and Work Package
f02_Associated_Deliverable_and_Work_Pack.guidance: The corresponding project deliverable, subsystem, or WBS component measured.

f03_Process_Efficiency_Metric.label: Process Efficiency Metric
f03_Process_Efficiency_Metric.guidance: Process measurement evaluating cycle times, throughput, sprint burndown, or rework rates.

f04_Defect_Density_and_Severity_Threshol.label: Defect Density and Severity Thresholds
f04_Defect_Density_and_Severity_Threshol.guidance: Allowable defect counts categorized by severity level (Critical, Major, Minor).

f05_Measurement_Frequency_and_Tooling.label: Measurement Frequency and Tooling
f05_Measurement_Frequency_and_Tooling.guidance: How often data is collected and the specific testing tools or inspection techniques used.

f06_Acceptable_Tolerance_Range_and_Escal.label: Acceptable Tolerance Range and Escalation Trigger
f06_Acceptable_Tolerance_Range_and_Escal.guidance: Upper and lower control limits (+/- tolerance) and triggers requiring corrective escalation.
